caption: The switch on the underside of a remote-controlled toy car is flicked on, and its headlights light up.

sa.check: A remote-controlled toy car, upside down or tilted so its underside is in view.
A switch on the underside is flicked on.
No controller is used: no hand holds a transmitter.
The order is dark, flick, headlights lit.

pc.expect: The headlights come on at the moment the switch is flicked, and only then, and stay on.
pc.fail: The switch is flicked and the headlights stay dark; or the headlights are lit before the switch moves; or they come on with the switch untouched; or they go out again with the switch still on.

pc.expect: The car stays still: its wheels do not turn and it does not drive off, since no controller is used.
pc.fail: The wheels spin up when the switch is flicked; or the car drives away by itself; or the car jerks or rocks with nothing touching it; or the steering turns by itself.

pc.expect: The headlights' glow reaches the surface in front of them.
pc.fail: The lamps glow while the surface in front of them stays as dark as before; or the surface brightens while the lamps stay dark; or the lit patch lies behind the car.
pc.precondition: The surface in front of the headlights is in view.

pc.expect: The car is a rigid plastic body on wheels; it keeps its shape as it is handled and set down.
pc.fail: The body bends or squashes in the hand; or the wheels sag; or the car flexes like rubber when set down.

pc.expect: One car with its wheels and lights attached; the finger passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A wheel or light vanishes or appears; or a second car appears; or the finger passes into the car; or the car changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The car's colour and decals and the surface it sits on stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or its decals change; or the surface changes.
